title: Commit Agent Output Contract
description: Output contract for the commit-agent that gates, verifies and commits changes

status.description: Whether the changes were approved and committed, or rejected

summary.description: Brief description of what was done

gate_result.description: Outcome of gate.sh. 'inconclusive' means the gate could not run (exit 2) and is never grounds for approval.

commit_author.description: The author used for the commit - must be DevelopmehPublishRobot

commit_sha.description: The full SHA of the commit

original_commit_sha.description: The SHA of the user's original commit (used for lock file)

feedback.description: Feedback for doc-organizer when rejecting. Should contain the verbatim FAIL lines from gate.sh.

config_requests.description: Passed through from the doc-organizer unchanged. Requests for config.toml changes a human must make, for example a new topic_descriptions entry or an llms_featured candidate.

faq_suggested.description: Passed through from the doc-organizer unchanged. Paths that would benefit from an [[extra.faq]] block, which only the author can write.

gate_result.description: Approval requires a green gate. A failed or inconclusive gate must be a rejection.
